title: Long Distance — EN/SN/ES (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Spanish heritage diaspora family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The long distance call used to cost by the minute and we knew it
Every word we chose was chosen carefully — we grew into it
My mother's voice across the line from Zimbabwe to Perth
Was timed to fit inside the affordable bracket of its worth

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Foni reurefu rakanga richida mari yakawanda
[The long distance call used to cost a great deal of money]
Takadzidzira kusarudza mazwi akakosha zvikuru
[We learned to choose only the most important words]
Inzwi ramai rakauya kusvika kuAustralia
[Mother's voice came all the way to Australia]
Inzwi rayo rakaita kuti musha uve pedyo
[Her voice made home feel near]

[Chorus — English]
Long distance, long distance
The telephone line across the Indian Ocean night
Long distance, long distance
We talked in code for love because the price was tight
Long distance knows what can be said in thirty seconds flat
Long distance knows that voice itself is where the home is at

[Bridge — Spanish, with English translation]
La llamada de larga distancia costaba por minuto
[The long distance call cost by the minute]
Cada palabra era elegida con cuidado y tributo
[Every word was chosen carefully and with care]
La voz de mi madre desde Zimbabwe hasta Perth
[My mother's voice from Zimbabwe to Perth]
Era el sonido del amor dentro del precio y su red
[Was the sound of love within the price and its reach]

[Outro — All three languages]
Long distance knows… Foni reurefu rinoziva… La larga distancia sabe
The voice is home — Inzwi ndimusha — La voz es el hogar
The gardens still growing
